pictures.subject: isometric
pictures.name: Hollowmouth
pictures.prompt: Redraw this game map as an isometric view: 16-bit pixel art in the style of Stardew Valley, the same place seen from above at an angle. Keep its layout: every building, wall, path, fence, water and open ground where the map has it, the same size and shape, in the same places relative to each other. Add nothing the map does not show. What is on it: Hollowmouth, A grim mining town of rust-streaked prefab blocks and iron walkways under a cracked pressure dome. Grey dust on every surface; sodium lamps; loudspeakers on every corner. In it: The barracks: A long concrete blockhouse by the south wall, cold and damp, with rows of iron bunks. The penal detachment is quartered here; The Chapel of the Engine: A soot-black chapel with a tall spire, its doors carved with the God-Engine's gears. Confessor Hesk preaches here at every shift change; The Overseer's Bastion: A squat fortified block on the town's only rise, with gun slits, a vox mast and the overseer's quarters at the top; The refinery: A tangle of pipes, vats and smokestacks belching orange flame through the dome. Half its workers have not reported for a week; The scrapmarket: A crowded square of stalls made of crates and tarpaulin, where miners trade ration bars, scrap, rumours and contraband; The landing field: A cracked rockcrete pad under the dome's open north lock, scorched black by landing jets; The pithead gate: A heavy blast gate in the dome's east wall, where the rail line runs out to Shaft Nine. Two guards in rebreathers never let it stand open. Marked on the map: blast gate, iron walkway, sodium lamp, sodium lamp, loudspeaker, loudspeaker, vox mast, smokestack, landing jetscorch. The ground: a station's metal decks, in space. Full-bleed scene, atmospheric light. No writing of any kind: no labels, names, captions, arrows or signs, and no border.

pictures.prompt: Redraw this game map as an isometric view: 16-bit pixel art in the style of Stardew Valley, the same place seen from above at an angle.
